newsitem.title: USA: LUFTHANSA CARGO INBOUND/OUTBOUND UP IN JULY.
newsitem.headline: LUFTHANSA CARGO INBOUND/OUTBOUND UP IN JULY.

text.p: Lufthansa's combined inbound/outbound cargo volume at New York's John F. Kennedy Airport rose 28.6 percent to 10,528 tonnes in July over the same 1996 month, a company spokesman told Reuters.
The carrier imported 5,626 tonnes of cargo in July, 27 percent above the 4,429 tonnes a year earlier.
Lufthansa's export side climbed 30.5 percent to 4,902 tonnes in July, against 3,755 tonnes in July 1996.

In July, Lufthansa imported more consolidated freight and finished apparel than any other commodity. Outbound, general consolidated freight continued to fill its aircraft. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
